tracks.title: 패딩 좀 들어 줘
tracks.mood: pent-up and deadpan in the verses, then a jump-until-closing release in the fast chorus
tracks.subject: Jiwoo, 96% 'I' on every MBTI test, is dragged to a Hongdae club by three 'E' friends and stands at the wall holding four padded coats, until her song drops at 1 a.m.; she hands the coats over and out-jumps them all until closing.
